title: A world and character index
description: The accepted facts are tied to the manuscript, and possible contradictions are there to be checked.

blocks.text: Names, relationships and the rules of the world change as the work goes on. A separate note soon stops matching the chapters.

quote.text: I was looking for something in which i could organize my thoughts and try to get facts down about my world when I came across fortelling.

blocks.text: Keep the confirmed details and the places where they appeared. When a new chapter arrives, show the possible discrepancy next to the original passage.
Keep a rough idea apart from the canon. The assistant offers to check a contradiction, but it must not quietly rewrite a character or the plot.
